messages:
alex: FYI saw a p99 jump on /v1/chat during the rollout. p50 stable, p99 spiked ~600ms. Minute bucket sample_count=9. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/rollout-xyz
maya: small-n territory. Do we show merged-aggregate or per-slice by default now?
rachel: We show per-slice lines when variants exist; small cohorts can dominate visible p99s.
eng-sre-john: raw samples for the bucket:
```
window:2026-06-07T18:12Z
endpoint:/v1/chat (slice=canary)
sample_count:9
latencies_ms:[18,21,23,25,27,29,310,320,330]
```
alex: with n=9 p99 is basically one of the top samples. UI smoothing also propagated the spike across 3 windows which made it look worse.
product-emma: Proposal: show a "Low confidence (n=9)" badge next to percentiles when sample_count<20 and a tooltip: "Percentile estimates unstable for small samples. Click to view raw samples."
maya: +1. Also expose both tdigest_estimate and empirical_value when count<200; lazy-load raw samples on click.
eng-sre-john: Alert change: gate p99 SLO alerts when raw_count<30 to avoid false positives from tiny cohorts.
telemetry-bot: action created: ENG-PLAT-1991 "Percentile confidence badge + alert gating" assigned to maya, due 2026-06-14.
